description.value: The Library Lounge is an intimate cocktail lounge and full-service dining room at the heart of Nelson's historic Hume Hotel, a property whose bar and fireplace are restorations of the original 1898 splendour. The room features a monumental brick hearth, original caryatids and mouldings, and a cozy parlour-like atmosphere anchored by live jazz several nights a week. Touring cyclists arriving in Nelson will find a complete food and beverage menu, local craft beer, and craft cocktails in one of the Kootenays' most storied hospitality venues.
